description: Compare two companies' trading activity, in any of the 13 markets: each one's dollar volume over the latest session or the last 5 or 20, versus normal, σ and percentile against its own year; which is further above its own normal; and, in the same sector and market, each one's share of it. No prices or price changes.

ticker_a.description: A ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, Lumentum or 7203.T. A market may lead it, as Japan:7203.T.

ticker_b.description: A ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, Lumentum or 7203.T. A market may lead it, as Japan:7203.T.

window.description: Sessions: 1, 5 or 20 (or a week or a month). Default 1 (the latest session).

name: infinity_compare_activity
title: Compare two companies
